test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Find Compound Interest on ₹11,000 in 2 years at 4% p.a., interest compounded yearly.
solution:
Given

principle =11000

time=2 yrs

rate=4%

Solution

Formula used

A=P(1+(r)/(100))^t

A is the amount obtained

A=11000(1+(4)/(100))²=11,897.6 Rs

interest=amount-principle=11897.6-11000 = **897.6 Rs**

**The compound interest obtained is 897.6 Rs**.
